description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for an IPC server in the Rialto project, including classes for server creation, client management, socket handling, and message processing.

classes.name: ServerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC server instances.

classes.name: ServerImpl
classes.description: Main implementation of the IPC server, managing clients, sockets, and message processing.

classes.name: ServerImpl::Socket
classes.description: Represents a listening socket with associated file descriptors and callbacks.

classes.name: ServerImpl::ClientDetails
classes.description: Holds details about connected clients, including socket and callback information.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the IPC server.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Adds a new socket to listen for incoming client connections.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a new client based on a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the server's main socket file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event message to a specified client.

methods.name: isClientConnected
methods.description: Checks if a client is currently connected.

methods.name: disconnectClient
methods.description: Disconnects a client by its ID.

methods.name: processNewConnection
methods.description: Handles a new incoming connection on a socket.

methods.name: processClientSocket
methods.description: Processes activity on a client socket.

methods.name: processClientMessage
methods.description: Processes a message received from a client.

methods.name: processMethodCall
methods.description: Handles a method call received from a client.

methods.name: addClientSocket
methods.description: Creates and adds a new client based on a socket.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to a client.

methods.name: sendErrorReply
methods.description: Sends an error reply to a client.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles a response message from the server controller.

methods.name: populateReply
methods.description: Prepares a reply message with response data.
